description: This file defines interfaces for warning reporting within the WPEFramework. It declares external structures for warning events, warning reporting units, and a nested interface for warning control, including methods for event serialization, configuration, exclusion, and management of warning categories.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface representing a warning event with methods for serialization, deserialization, categorization, and string representation.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units managing warning events, including category information and category list management via embedded control interface.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Nested interface for controlling warning categories, allowing exclusion, configuration, and cloning of category control objects.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Exclude a specified warning category from reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configure the warning reporting control with specific settings.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a copy of the warning reporting control instance.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Report a warning event with a specific identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieve information about a warning category, including whether it is default, enabled, its exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Add a warning category to the list of categories managed by the reporting unit.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Remove a warning category from the list of categories managed by the reporting unit.
